entities.name: PMID:25079964
observations: Cross-sectional study of 1,215 people in Mbeya, southwestern Tanzania; 18% had anti-alphavirus IgG. Authors inferred widespread alphavirus exposure consistent with endemic chikungunya circulation.
Abstract reports broad anti-alphavirus IgG, so seropositivity alone does not establish CHIKV-specific infection or contemporaneous transmission.

entities.name: Mbeya alphavirus serology
observations: In 1,215 Mbeya-region participants, 18% were alphavirus IgG positive; positivity varied with age and geography, supporting prior widespread exposure but not proving ongoing CHIKV-specific transmission.
